name: openai
summary: Run the store's AI features on OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible server.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.comment: Your OpenAI API key; a keyless OpenAI-compatible server (commerce.ai.config.baseUrl) needs none

next: Set commerce.ai.config.model in nymbal.config.ts to the model the provider serves (for example gpt-4o-mini): the store does not start until it is set.
For an OpenAI-compatible server (a gateway, Ollama, vLLM), set commerce.ai.config.baseUrl to its API URL.
